metadata.title: Secure IoT

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating Internet of Things devices in a trustworthy, governed, and secure manner.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that IoT devices are identifiable, trustworthy, lifecycle‑managed, and produce protected telemetry.

metadata.remarks: Secure IoT is a composite pattern asserting that Internet of Things devices are governed through strong device identity, attestation, lifecycle management, and telemetry protection. This pattern introduces no independent controls and may be claimed only when all constituent IoT capability patterns are realized.

components.title: IoT Device Core
components.description: Definition and classification of IoT devices, trust boundaries, and baseline operational assumptions.

components.title: IoT Device Identity
components.description: Provisioning, binding, and authentication of cryptographic identities for IoT devices.

components.title: IoT Device Attestation
components.description: Verification of firmware, software, and runtime state of IoT devices before and during operation.

components.title: IoT Device Lifecycle
components.description: Secure provisioning, update, maintenance, and decommissioning of IoT devices.

components.title: IoT Telemetry Data Protection
components.description: Authentication, integrity, confidentiality, and policy enforcement for IoT telemetry and command data.
